short_summary: HealthRate, Inc. executed a $500,000 Convertible Promissory Note with First Trust Capital Partners, LLC, maturing on August 30, 2026, bearing an interest rate of 18% per annum. The note includes conversion provisions and was signed by Tim Michaels, CEO of HealthRate, and James A. Bowen, Chairman of First Trust Capital Partners.
long_summary: The document is an executed Convertible Promissory Note in which HealthRate, Inc., a Nevada corporation, promises to pay First Trust Capital Partners, LLC the principal sum of $500,000 plus interest at an annual rate of 18%. The note matures on August 30, 2026 and includes default, conversion, and miscellaneous provisions. Signature blocks show Tim Michaels, Chief Executive Officer of HealthRate, Inc., and James A. Bowen, Chairman of First Trust Capital Partners, LLC, with contact details provided. The note specifies that it has not been registered under the Securities Act and outlines the rights of the holder upon default.
